questions.question: The Panchayat Raj system is based on the principles of which of the following reports?
questions.explanation: Based on the Balwantray Mehta Committee report.

questions.question: Which of the following Articles in the Indian Constitution provides the power of Judicial Review to the Supreme Court?
questions.explanation: Provides the power of Judicial Review to the Supreme Court.

questions.question: The West Bengal Panchayat Act of which year provides for the three-tier Panchayat system in the state?
questions.explanation: Provides for the three-tier Panchayat system in the state.

questions.question: The Right to Information Act, 2005, was enacted to provide for the right to information which is a fundamental right under Article?
questions.explanation: Article 19(1)(b) provides the right to freedom of speech and expression.

questions.question: The concept of 'Preamble' in the Constitution of India is based on the model of the United States Constitution, which was adopted in the year?
questions.explanation: The United States Constitution was adopted in 1787.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers forms the western boundary of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Hooghly River is a major distributary of the Ganga River.

questions.question: The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway passes through how many districts of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway passes through 5 districts: Darjeeling, Jalpaiguri, Cooch Behar, Alipurduar, and Kalimpong.

questions.question: The Sundarbans National Park is located in which of the following districts of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans National Park is located in South 24 Parganas district.

questions.question: Which of the following mountain ranges is located in North Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Sikkim Himalayas are a part of the Eastern Himalayas mountain range.

questions.question: The Ganges-Brahmaputra delta is also known as which of the following?
questions.explanation: The Ganges-Brahmaputra delta is also known as the Bengal Delta.

questions.question: Which of the following is a flagship programme of the West Bengal government to improve healthcare infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Launched to provide free health insurance to 7.6 crore citizens of West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the main objective of the Kanyashree Prakalpa scheme of the West Bengal government?
options: To provide financial assistance to the families of martyrs
To improve the educational status of girls
To provide vocational training to the rural youth
To provide scholarships to meritorious students
questions.explanation: To incentivize girls to continue their education beyond Class X.

questions.question: Which of the following schemes is launched by the West Bengal government to provide pension to the rural and urban poor?
questions.explanation: To provide financial assistance to the elderly and destitute women.

questions.question: What is the main goal of the Bangla Sahayata Kendra Scheme of the West Bengal government?
options: To provide employment to the unemployed youth
To provide financial assistance to the small entrepreneurs
To provide free legal aid to the poor
To provide digital literacy training to the rural people
questions.explanation: To facilitate online services to the citizens.

questions.question: Which of the following initiatives was launched by the West Bengal government to promote the use of digital payments?
questions.explanation: To promote digital transactions and reduce cash usage.

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 10,000 is invested for 2 years at an interest rate of 8% per annum. Find the simple interest for 2 years.
questions.explanation: Using the simple interest formula.

questions.question: What is the compound interest on Rs. 8,000 for 1 year at an interest rate of 10% per annum compounded annually?
questions.explanation: Using the compound interest formula.

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 5,000 is borrowed at 12% per annum simple interest. How much amount will be paid after 3 years?
questions.explanation: Adding the simple interest to the principal amount.

questions.question: If a sum of Rs. 12,000 is invested at compound interest rate of 6% per annum for 2 years, then what will be the amount after 2 years?
questions.explanation: Using the compound interest formula.

questions.question: A person invested Rs. 15,000 for 2 years at 9% per annum compound interest. Find the amount after 2 years.
questions.explanation: Using the compound interest formula.

questions.question: A tap can fill 2/3rd of a 1000-liter tank in 30 minutes. How much of the tank can be filled in 45 minutes?
questions.explanation: The tap can fill 2/3rd of the tank in 30 minutes.

questions.question: Two pipes can fill a tank in 4 hours and 6 hours respectively. They worked together for 2 hours. Then, the first pipe was stopped and the second pipe continued to fill the tank. How much more time was required to fill the tank?
questions.explanation: The first pipe fills 1/4 of the tank in 2 hours.

questions.question: A pump can empty a tank in 12 hours. How much of the tank will be filled by a pipe that can fill 1/4 of the tank in 3 hours in 4 hours?
questions.explanation: The pump empties 1/12 of the tank in 1 hour.

questions.question: A group of 8 men can finish a job in 12 days. How many men are required to finish the same job in 6 days?
questions.explanation: 8 men can finish the job in 12 days.

questions.question: A tank is filled by two pipes A and B. Pipe A can fill 1/4 of the tank in 6 hours and pipe B can fill 1/4 of the tank in 8 hours. If both pipes work together, how long will it take to fill the tank?
questions.explanation: Pipe A fills 1/24 of the tank in 1 hour.

questions.question: A train travels from Kolkata to Asansol at an average speed of 60 km/h. If the distance between the two cities is 120 km, how many hours will it take?
questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed.

questions.question: A car travels from Siliguri to Gangtok at an average speed of 40 km/h, covering a distance of 240 km. How many hours will it take to cover the remaining 160 km?
questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed.

questions.question: A bus travels at an average speed of 30 km/h, covering a distance of 180 km in 6 hours. How much distance will it cover in 3 hours?
questions.explanation: Distance = Speed x Time.

questions.question: A train travels from Sealdah to Bardhaman at an average speed of 50 km/h, covering a distance of 200 km. How much time will it take to cover the remaining 150 km?
questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed.

questions.question: A taxi travels at an average speed of 25 km/h, covering a distance of 120 km. How much time will it take to cover a distance of 180 km?
questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed.

questions.question: If 4 is represented by #, then what is 13 represented by?
questions.explanation: In this pattern, each number is represented by one '#'.

questions.question: If 'SUN' is coded as 'MON', then 'TUE' is coded as?
questions.explanation: The given pattern shifts each day by one.

questions.question: If 'BIRLA' is coded as 'BRAIL', then 'MAHARANA' is coded as?
questions.explanation: The given pattern replaces each letter with the next letter in the alphabet.

questions.question: If 1 is represented by 'A', 2 is represented by 'B', 3 is represented by 'C', then 11 is represented by?
questions.explanation: In this pattern, each digit is represented by the corresponding alphabet.

questions.question: If 'CALCUTTA' is coded as 'KOLKATA', then 'HOWRAH' is coded as?
questions.explanation: The given pattern replaces 'CALCUTTA' with 'KOLKATA'.

questions.question: Dilip's paternal grandfather is the paternal grandfather of which one of the following relatives of Dilip?
questions.explanation: Dilip and his paternal grandfather are father and son.

questions.question: If A is the mother of B and B is the daughter of D, Then who is the mother of D?
questions.explanation: B's mother is A, so D is B's paternal grandmother.

questions.question: A and B are two persons. A's son is B's brother. Which of the following is correct about the relationship of A and B?
options: A is the father of B
A is the brother of B
A is the son of B
A is the brother of B's father
questions.explanation: B's brother is A's son.

questions.question: If A is the father of C and C is the son of D, Then who is the grandfather of D?
questions.explanation: D's son is C, and C's father is A.

questions.question: In a family, there is a man, his wife, their daughter and their daughter's son. Who is the grandfather of the son?
questions.explanation: The man is the son's paternal grandfather.
